notes: The LBB4540/32 is a handheld, battery-powered Integrus infrared pocket receiver for 32-channel simultaneous interpretation/language distribution (not a rack/mains AV device). Source: official Bosch Security Systems datasheet "LBB 4540 Integrus Pocket Receivers" (doc 1846631435, en, V2, 23 Nov 2012), hosted on Bosch's successor brand Keenfinity's resource CDN, explicitly listing LBB4540/32 as the 32-channel order variant alongside /04 and /08. Category/type in this schema (audio/Wireless mic) is an approximation — no better fit exists for an IR conference-language pocket receiver; it is a receiver, not a transmitter/mic. Only one standard physical connector exists: a 3.5 mm stereo headphone output jack. Other interconnections are non-standard and omitted from the ports list per the connector enum: (1) battery contacts for 2x AA alkaline cells (internal battery compartment, not an external I/O port), (2) a proprietary connector for the LBB4550/00 NiMH battery pack accessory, and (3) proprietary charging contacts on the left side of the unit for docking with LBB4560 charging cases/cabinets (these are pogo-pin style contacts, not a listed connector type like dc-barrel/pogo — the unit has no direct AC/DC power-input jack of its own since charging is accomplished only via the separate charging dock accessory). No rack units (it is a handheld device, ~155x45x30 mm, 75-125 g). No bandwidth grade applies (IR/analog audio device, not a graded digital connector).
